user.title: Connect to Beaam
user.description: Enter the local address of your NEOOM Beaam and an API token.

data_description.beaam_ip: IP address or hostname of the Beaam in your network, for example 192.168.1.50.
data_description.api_token: API key for the BEAAM API. Create it at connect.neoom.com under Access management > API keys.

error.invalid_ip: Please enter the IP address of the Beaam.
error.invalid_auth: The Beaam rejected the API token.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Beaam. Check the IP address and that the Beaam is reachable.
